description: Safety Roadside Rest Areas is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. Caltrans provides Safety Roadside Rest Areas as a part of the State Highway System pursuant to Streets and Highways Code, Sections 218-226.5. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are California, Caltrans, Division of Maintenance, Rest Areas, SRRA, Safety Roadside Rest Area, California Department of Transportation, CAOpenData. The bounding box given is -124.1507,32.7374,-114.8903,41.9685. The hub shows 2026-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public – data could be made publicly available without restrictions.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
